sources.label: A collection of Morphe patches.
sources.author: Globberry
patch_list: Always accept the paid-export purchase check (LP0JcGi9.MeOIJuj).
Log the whole export flow to logcat (tag KFPro). Read with: adb logcat -s KFPro
Show a toast naming the reason the export was cancelled.
Neuters PairIP license verification so the app runs without a valid license.
Forces all Pro features enabled, keeps Pro active after signer checks, and unlocks Pro exports (including the paid-export receipt check).
Forces the app's signer identity, signature checks, and signer-identity string to match the original publisher certificate.
